name: launch-check
description: This skill should be used when assessing launch readiness and missing Soleur engineering practices in an existing repository.

findings.excerpt: LC="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/launch-check/scripts/launch-check.sh"
bash "$LC" render --target . --facts "$W/facts.tsv" --judged "$W/judged.tsv" --dry-run
bash "$LC" issues --preview --target . --facts "$W/facts.tsv" --judged "$W/judged.tsv"
bash "$LC" issues --create --target . --facts "$W/facts.tsv" --judged "$W/judged.tsv" --plan <dir> --confirm-repo <owner/name> --confirm-count <N>
case "<plan= path>" in */lc-issues-plan.??????) [ -d "<plan= path>" ] && [ ! -L "<plan= path>" ] && rm -r -- "<plan= path>" ;; esac

check "a v2 guard is not emitted as a gap" bash -c '! grep -q "BASE-block-rm-rf" "$1"' _ "$SCRATCH/h.tsv"
check "empty manifest: exit 2 reason=baseline-source-empty (not 0 baseline checks)" bash -c '[ "$1" = 2 ] && grep -q "reason=baseline-source-empty" "$2"' _ "$rc
check "a second v1 row appended after a compliant first is emitted too" bash -c 'grep -q "^BASE-guard-x" "$1" && grep -q "^BASE-secret-scan" "$1"' _ "$SCRATCH/p
check "no checks.tsv row duplicates a derived guard (double count)" bash -c '! grep -q "^BASE-" "$1"' _ "$SKILL/references/checks.tsv"
check "baseline.sh does not hard-code a guard name" bash -c '! grep -nE "secret-scan|commit-on-main|block-stash|orphan-test" "$1" | grep -v "^[0-9]*:[[:space:]]
check "baseline-domains.tsv uses only known domains and severities" bash -c 'x=$(awk -F"\t" "!/^#/ && \$1 != \"name\" && \$1 != \"\" && (\$2 !~ /^(security|test
check "no catalog id appears in retired-checks.tsv (a retired id cannot come back with a stale acceptance)" bash -c 'ids=$(awk -F"\t" "!/^#/ && \$1 != \"id\" &&
check "a one-guard manifest derives exactly one BASE- check" bash -c '[ "$1" = 0 ] && grep -q "^BASE-x-guard" "$2"' _ "$rc" "$SCRATCH/gl.tsv"
check "a manifest header that lost the emits column is malformed (not merely empty)" bash -c '[ "$1" = 2 ] && grep -q "reason=baseline-source-malformed" "$2"' _
check "a guard name outside [A-Za-z0-9-] is refused (its BASE- id would fail verify-report)" bash -c '[ "$1" = 2 ] && grep -q "reason=baseline-source-malformed"
export ST; export -f kv cj   # used inside `bash -c` check bodies
check "stub contract: an unknown flag exits 64 and is refused (not recorded as a call)" bash -c '[ "$1" = 64 ] && [ "$2" = 0 ] && [ -s "$3" ]' _ "$rc" "$(n_call
check "stub contract: a string-typed sub_issue_id (-f) is a 422 and logged as a violation" bash -c '[ "$1" = 1 ] && [ -s "$2" ]' _ "$rc" "$ST/violations.log"
check "stub contract: the integer form links the child to its parent" bash -c '[ "$1" = 0 ] && [ "$(jq "[.[]|select(.parent==101)]|length" "$2")" = 1 ]' _ "$rc"
check "stub contract: --paginate with a forced page size serves every row across 4 pages" bash -c '[ "$1" = 7 ] && [ "$(cut -f2 "$2")" = 4 ]' _ "$cnt" "$ST/page
